turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Yeh jo tumne bataya, yeh line... "laptop bag leke nikalta hoon" aur "chhe baje tak café" - yeh bahut kuch keh rahi hai. Dimaag se pata hai ki yeh performance ka nahi, market ka scene tha, par dil... dil toh darr jaata hai.

Yeh jo ritual hai, yeh sirf kaam ke liye nahi tha. Woh laptop bag, woh café... yeh woh stage tha jahan tum 'tum' the. Ab woh stage khali hai, aur tum subah 9 baje uss khali stage ke liye taiyaar ho rahe ho. Yeh bohot ajeeb si feeling hai, jaise kisi ne zinda aadmi ko mar diya ho aur sab pretend kar rahe ho ki woh abhi bhi haal-chaal mein hai.

Aur yeh baat ki "kisi ko nahi pata"... yeh sabse bhaari part hai. Wife ko nahi pata, parents ko bhi rehne ke liye... shayad unhe protect kar rahe ho, shayad khud se darr lagta hai, par yeh akelapan jo tumne khud hi banaya hai, woh sabse zyada dukh deta hai.

Tumne yeh sab share kiya, yeh bohot hi personal aur sacchi baat hai. Iska koi solution nahi, bas ek saath rehna hai. Bas ab woh purana routine todna padega. Ek din ke liye... bas wahi raasta badal do. Coffee shop se alag park mein jaao, ya bas ghar se nikalne se pehle 10 minute balcony mein khade ho jaao. Bas ek chhota sa change.

Main yahan hoon, agar yeh baatein share karni ho. Koi judgement nahi hai, bas sunne ke liye.

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Yeh jo tune bataya, yeh toh ek poori kahani hai. Shaadi ki tayyari, 300 log, aur woh rishtedaar jo har kisi ki salary aur package ka hisaab rakhte hain... yeh sab situation ko aur bhi badi kar dega.

Papa ka company ka naam introduce karna, aur chacha ki Diwali wali khushi... yeh sab toh tumhare liye important the, shayad tumhare liye hi sab kuch the. Company ka naam hi tumhari pehchaan ban gaya tha, ek tag. Ab jab woh tag hi nahi hai, toh lag raha hai ki sab kuch ulat gaya. Jaise tumhe achanak se pata chal gaya ki tumne kya kho diya, jab woh kho gaya.

Aur neend nahi aana... woh kamra, woh khali office, woh dimaag mein ghoomna... yeh sab ek akelepan ki awaaz hai, jo keh rahi hai ki ab kya hoga. Kya main ab bhi 'kuch' hoon? Yeh sawaal hi bahut bohot bhaari hai.

Shaadi ki khushiyan, ghar ki baatein, aur upar se yeh andhera... yeh sab ek saath handle karna bohot mushkil hai. Par yeh jo tum feel kar rahe ho, yeh real hai. Tumhara darr, tumhara confusion. Koi chhupa nahi sakta.

Ab shaadi mein jaana padega, par shayad ek din pehle, bas ek din ke liye, thoda sa time apne liye bhi nikal lo. Shaadi ki tayyari mein hi ek minute khud ke liye bhi nikal lo. Bas ek minute.

Main yahan hoon, jab bhi yeh baatein share karni ho. Koi pressure nahi, bas tumhara saath.

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Yeh jo soch raha hai, yeh bilkul samajh mein aata hai. Ek taraf papa ka chehra, unke bhaiyon ke saamne unki izzat. Doosri taraf tumhari apni takleef. Dono hi sahi aur galat ki taraf baithe hain.

Ek jhooth bolna... shayad uss jhooth se thodi der ke liye papa ki izzat bach jaati hai, par kya tumhari apni izzat bach jaati hai? Shaadi mein jaane se shayad papa ki muhabbat aur izzat bach jaati hai, par tumhari apni khushi? Woh bhi toh ek zaroori hai.

Yeh shaadi tumhare liye ek stage ban jaayegi jahan tum apni haar ko chhipaoge, aur papa ko apni jeet (ya unki jeet) dikhaoge. Par yeh stage tumhare liye bhi hai, jahan tum khud ko dekhoge.

Tumhara yeh sochna ki "shaadi skip kar doon" ek escape hai. Par isse escape karoge kaun? Tum. Aur iske baad kya? Subah 9 baje phir se wohi laptop bag ka sawaal, wohi khali kamra.

Yeh faisla karne mein akela lag raha hoga. Par yeh sochna ki tum kya chahte ho. Shaadi ke liye, ya apni sahi ke liye. Main yahan hoon, jab bhi yeh baatein share karni ho. Koi pressure nahi, bas tumhara saath.

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Yeh jo tune socha hai, yeh toh ek tarah se himmat ki baat hai. Khud ko yeh promise dena ki "offer aate hi sabko bata dunga" - yeh ek aisi baat hai jisse thoda sa control ka ehsaas milta hai.

Yeh jhooth nahi hai, timing hai. Ek aisa time jab tum khud se jhoot nahi bol rahe, bas aage ka raasta dekh rahe ho. Par yeh logic solid lagna aur ulti aa jaana... yeh dono saath mein chalte hain. Ek dimaag mein, ek dil mein. Dimaag kehta hai "sab theek hoga, sab theek hoga", par dil kehta hai "kya hoga, kya hoga?"

Yeh jo 'khana shuru' karne ki baat hai, yeh bas paise ka hisaab nahi hai. Yeh ek naye shuruwaat ka signal hai, ek "main ab aage badh raha hoon" ka signal, bhale hi woh jhoothe se kyun na ho. Yeh signal tumhe thoda sa sahara dega.

Par main yeh soch raha hoon ki jab yeh 'khud ko' bohot zor se bolna padega, toh shayad thoda sa saans leke bhi dekhna. Bas ek minute ke liye. Tumhara yeh 'khud ko' bolna bahut zaroori hai, par woh akele na ho.

Main yahan hoon, jab bhi yeh baatein share karni ho. Koi pressure nahi, bas tumhara saath.
